title: Cruise Upgrade Call
scenario: A caller offers a cabin upgrade if you pay by gift card before departure.

answers.A: Check upgrade offers inside the cruise booking.
answers.B: Buy gift cards and read the codes to the caller.
answers.C: Ask the caller to hold the upgrade while you check your booking.
answers.D: Call the cruise line using its official number.

explanation: Gift cards are not a normal cruise-upgrade payment method. The caller wants value that is hard to recover; verify through the cruise line.
proTip: Gift-card payment requests are a full stop, not a special offer.
